lines.text: Many learners say: He explained to me the lesson.
Better: He explained the lesson to me.
Say the thing first, then to me.
The second! Show the map to me.

data.wrong: He explained to me the lesson.
data.right: He explained the lesson to me.
data.why: Say the thing first, then to me.

native.tip: نقول «شرح لي الدرس»، أما في الإنجليزية فنقول the lesson أولًا: “He explained the lesson to me.” وليس “He explained to me the lesson.”
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا هذه الجملة؟ “He explained to me the lesson.” 😅 نقول «شرح لي الدرس»، أما في الإنجليزية فنقول the lesson أولًا، فالجملة الصحيحة “He explained the lesson to me.” استمع إلى Carlos وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.
native.comment: الإجابة: “Show the map to me.” — نقول «شرح لي الدرس»، أما في الإنجليزية فنقول الشيء أولًا ثم to me. قلها بصوت عالٍ ثم اكتب جملة من عندك: {link}

en.tip: In Arabic we say «شرح لي الدرس», but in English the lesson comes first: “He explained the lesson to me.” not “He explained to me the lesson.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “He explained to me the lesson.” 😅 In Arabic we say «شرح لي الدرس», but in English the lesson comes first, so the right sentence is “He explained the lesson to me.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
